title: Sensitivity analyses SA1 (without BL-01 benchmark), X01 (post-freeze, without auto-closed cells) and SA2 (Q10)
population: BASE paired with FINAL[v]; FINAL[v1] vs FINAL[v2]; SA1 without the BL-01 benchmark cells; X01 without base cells with an auto-closed artifact
notes: SA1 exclude_dense_la_00: repeat Q06/R02/R04/R05 without benchmark dense_la/00_dense_la_lu_decomp (BL-01 tolerance disclosure)
SA2 exclude_auto_closed: Q10: repeat Q06 without artifacts whose braces the pipeline auto-closed
SA3 per_block: every headline estimate per block (pilot, full_ext) next to the composite

One row per block, endpoint and hypothesis of the primary family (R04 per variant, R05 per variant pair): the frozen estimate, SA1 (without the BL-01 benchmark cells; its Q06 BASE / FINAL rates are checked on the identical SA1 cohort and given in the estimates) and the post-freeze X01 (without base cells with an auto-closed artifact; X01 and the frozen estimate rest on the same base cells before exclusion, and one X01 cohort serves every variant and comparison of a block and endpoint, checked; 'k excl.' counts the removed cells).

Denominator exclusions (methodology missingness rules; JSON key excluded): a cell marked 'k excl.' excludes k units (X01: base cell(s) removed by the auto-closed rule or outside the endpoint's paired cohort); cells without the mark exclude none; no unit is excluded in this table by R02 (base cell(s) outside the paired cohort); R04 (base cell(s) outside the paired cohort); Q10 (baseline_incompatible artifact(s)); R05 (base cell(s) outside the paired cohort).

POST-FREEZE (study_analysis_001.addendum_1, DECLARED_AFTER_DRY_RUN, declared 2026-10-17; descriptive, not part of the frozen methodology): X01 paired_auto_closed_sensitivity - post-freeze and descriptive; the exclusion depends on post-repair artifacts, i.e. it selects on a repair outcome - it shows sensitivity, not a corrected effect; reported next to the frozen R04/R05, never instead of them
BL01: Includes dense_la/00 (BL-01 tolerance convention: possible false FAIL verdicts; disclosure-bearing aggregate); sensitivity SA1 in T10.

IC1: Q06 is in-sample for test_feedback and combined_feedback: their loops see the ParEval test verdict and stop when it passes (every stopped_tests_pass trajectory is a Q06 pass), so they optimise the endpoint; for static_feedback Q06 is out-of-sample (measured once in phase 2, never seen by the loop). The variants therefore differ in trigger and stop rules, not only in feedback content; test_feedback cannot regress on Q06 by construction.

IC2: E02 is not an independent confirmation of Q06 gains: it counts build failures, and most E02 improvements are the same cells as the Q06 improvements; the held-out signal proper is the joint transition X06 (e.g. Q06 repaired but E02 still failing) and G01.

IC5: The composite primary estimates pool the pilot (12 clusters) and full_ext (48 clusters) blocks; the per-block estimates (T9b) are descriptive, the pilot ones approximate; a composite difference need not hold in both blocks.

IC6: static_feedback repair triggers are dominated by clang-tidy bugprone findings and, on MPI, by low-confidence hints (design document: no trustworthy static MPI tool exists); static_feedback results measure this frozen blocking-set configuration, not static analysis in general.

IC7: The pipeline auto-closes unbalanced braces before measurement; many static_feedback regressions are base-pass cells whose final repair answer was auto-closed and then failed to build (X01). Q10 (frozen SA2) is unpaired and compares different cohorts.

definitions.text: BASE: the 1,980 base cells (pilot_002 396 + full_ext_001 1,584), iteration-0 artifacts (use: initial code quality)

FINAL: for variant v: per base cell the artifact of the trajectory's terminal iteration (== STEP[v][2]); for trajectories terminal at iteration 0 the final artifact IS the base artifact (use: repair outcome per strategy on the identical 1,980-cell cohort)
R02 repair_success_rate: numerator = improved cells; denominator = cells failing the endpoint at baseline; unit = base cell.
R04 net_gain: numerator = improved - regressed; denominator = cells; unit = base cell.
R05 variant_difference: numerator = sum over cells of (y_v1 - y_v2); denominator = cells; unit = base cell.
Q10 correctness_pass_excluding_auto_closed: numerator = verdict == pass and auto_closed == false; denominator = artifacts with auto_closed == false; unit = artifact.
X01 paired_auto_closed_sensitivity: numerator = as R04 / R05 on the restricted cohort; denominator = restricted cohort cells (E02: with >= 1 valid pair); unit = base cell.

ci_note: 95% CI: nonparametric cluster bootstrap, percentile intervals, stratified by block (pilot benchmarks resampled among the 12 pilot benchmarks, full_ext among its 48); seed 20261017; cluster = benchmark; 2,000 replicates (descriptive, unadjusted); 10,000 replicates for the primary-family estimates (R04 composite with strata endpoint+variant, R05 composite with strata comparison+endpoint; Holm-adjusted tests in T9)
